content.short: Harvest Finance is an asset management protocol that helps yield farmers generate higher profits.
content.description: Harvest Finance is an asset management platform designed to help users maximize returns on assets stored in harvest vaults. By employing multiple yield farming strategies across diverse markets, the project aims to increase profits for its users. An anonymous core development team launched the initiative in September 2020, and within a month the total value locked on Harvest Finance surpassed $1 billion. The platform continues to refine its strategies and coordinate vault-based yield opportunities across supported networks.
